# routeros_ppp_l2tp_secret (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ppp_l2tp_secret" "secret" {
  address = "192.0.2.1"
  comment = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  secret  = "changeme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) Address or network of the remote peer this pre-shared key applies to. `0.0.0.0/0` matches any peer.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) IPsec pre-shared key used for the L2TP connections coming from `address`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ppp/l2tp-secret get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ppp_l2tp_secret.secret "*1"
```
